CustomField.description: The resolved cap on tool-calling iterations for the reply this step is part of (AIAgent__c.MaxToolCallingIterations__c, or the org default, clamped to AIAssistSettingsService's cap) - stored alongside ToolCallingIterationsUsed__c so the trace stays accurate even if that setting changes later.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set on every step of a reply, not just the last one - simpler to read back than a single summary row.
CustomField.label: Tool Calling Iterations Max
